_comment: Vendor peak dense FLOP/s PER DEVICE, used only to compute MFU.
IMPORTANT: verify every number against the vendor spec sheet before you
publish anything derived from it, and record where you got it in _source.
On Aurora the device is a TILE (ZE_FLAT_DEVICE_HIERARCHY=FLAT), so these
must be per-tile values -- roughly half the per-GPU figure. Leave a value
as null and MFU is omitted from the results rather than computed wrong.
Do not count sparsity-boosted 2:1 numbers; use dense figures only.

Data Center GPU Max._source: UNVERIFIED - fill in from Intel spec sheet, halve per-GPU to per-tile
Data Center GPU Max._note: Max 1550 = 2 tiles per GPU; these keys must be per-tile

A100._source: UNVERIFIED - check NVIDIA A100 datasheet for your SXM/PCIe variant

cpu._source: UNVERIFIED - Crux AMD EPYC, cores x FMA width x 2 x clock
